interface.shortDescription: Search global tenders and organizations across 180+ countries.
interface.longDescription: Search global tenders and organizations directly from Codex. Tenderwell brings AI-powered public procurement intelligence into your workflow, with tender data from 180+ countries, 600,000+ organizations, open and forecast opportunities, awarded tenders, advanced filters, and AI-enriched summaries. Whether you are finding new opportunities, tracking markets, researching buyers and competitors, or preparing a proposal, Tenderwell helps you cut through global procurement data without leaving your conversation.
defaultPrompt: Use Tenderwell MCP to search and read global tenders and organizations.
